description: This file defines the MyTrackerController class in the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a 'my-tracker' component in the preRender method.

classes.name: MyTrackerController
classes.description: Controller for handling the 'My Tracker' view in the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It extends AbstractVueController and initializes a Vue component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render hook that sets up the Vue component named 'my-tracker' before rendering the view.
